description: Five-turn chain: read prod port, change it, mirror to staging, recall staging's old port, then change staging retries. EXAM-CANARY-6f9c283b

files.conf/net.ini:
[prod]
host = api.prod.internal
port = 8080
retries = 3

[staging]
host = api.staging.internal
port = 8081
retries = 3

turns.prompt: conf/net.ini 里 prod 的端口现在是多少？
staging 的端口也跟 prod 保持一致。
对了，staging 原来的端口是多少来着？
好。最后把 staging 的 retries 改成 5，其他不动。
